alana: Quick sync — Acme cloud marketplace launch readiness. Embargo 2026-04-10 08:00 PT. Need landing page + press + SI onboarding + billing connector signoff by EOD Tue. Who's on which? :calendar:
miguel: I'll take listing copy and screenshots. ETA Tue noon. Do we have hero image from design?
sasha: Marketing — will draft press and blog. Confirm embargo window and embargoed asset folder. :white_check_mark:
alana: Embargo window confirmed with partner. Assets go to drive->partners/acme/embargo. Link: https://drive.redwood/partners/acme (internal)
ravi: Eng check — SSO + billing connector readiness: staging account created, need partner API key + test tenant. Running tests now.
deploy-bot: staging deployment succeeded for marketplace-service @ 2536000045 :rocket:
ravi: Quick note: SI integration requires schema change to onboarding API. PR in review: `github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/412` — needs eng-review by today.
harpreet: I'll own partner onboarding flows and SI docs. Will pair with Ravi to validate sample payloads. :+1:
ellen: Product — canary routing set to 5% for Acme tenants. Suggest monitoring for errors and latency for 48h post-release.
miguel: For listing copy — here's draft snippet:
```
name: Acme on Redwood
summary: High-throughput inference via Acme's infra + Redwood unified runtime.
cta: Get started — free trial
```
Need product approval.
sasha: Can we include joint quotes? Partner legal pushed one: "Acme + Redwood = a reliable path to production AI" — I'll inline and get sign-off.
alana: Checklist (quick):
- Landing page content (miguel) — due Tue 12:00
- Press + blog (sasha) — due Tue 17:00 embargoed
- SI docs + sample payloads (harpreet/ravi) — due Mon EOD
- Billing connector test (ravi) — done by Mon
- Legal sign-off on quote (sasha) — due Mon noon
- Final deploy to prod and tag release (eng) — Wed 02:00 UTC

Assigning owners above. If you see blockers reply here. :eyes:
miguel: small ask — do we have the partner logo in svg and 2x PNG? design?
alana: design pinged. @sophie (design) can you drop logos in the drive folder? :pray:
sasha: Also, social handles and partner exec bios — need from Acme PR. @alana can you confirm point of contact?
alana: Acme contact is jessica.liu@acme.com and their PR is matt@acme.com. I asked for bios, should get by EOD.
ravi: Running nightly regression on staging now; will post results here in morning.
miguel: thumbs — I'll prep screenshots and mobile/responsive checks.
press-bot: embargo_note: 'Acme marketplace announcement' registered for 2026-04-10 08:00 PT by @sasha
sasha: thanks all. If no blockers, I'll schedule embargo and draft the announcement thread for Tuesday. :v:
alana: Great — weekly sync tomorrow 10:00 to verify all green. If anything slips ping here ASAP.
sophie: logos uploaded to drive/partners/acme/assets (svg/png) :white_check_mark:
ravi: regression passed on staging — attach: `staging-regression-2536000120.log` (internal)
miguel: Done — first pass screenshots uploaded. Need final copy tweaks.
sasha: I'll do final pass after legal quote lands. Otherwise looks good. :clap:
alana: Closing note: we'll keep canary at 5% for 48h then ramp. Thanks team. /end
